issue.title: requests.utils.parse_dict_header returns malformed dictionary when header contains unquoted semicolons in cookie string
issue.body:
### Description
When parsing a header with `parse_dict_header`, if a value contains an unquoted semicolon, the parser splits on semicolon prematurely and corrupts the resulting key-value pairs.

### Steps to Reproduce
```python
from requests.utils import parse_dict_header
header = 'foo=bar; baz=qux; extra=value'
res = parse_dict_header(header)
print(res)
```

### Expected Behavior
Properly parses all key-value items into a dictionary.

### Actual Behavior
Keys with unquoted values get mangled or stripped.
